advertisers.description: Specific Advertisers to sync.  Must be populated if `sync_mode` is set to `SpecificAdvertisers`.

click_attribution_window.description: The number of days to use as the conversion attribution window for a 'click' action.

conversion_report_time.description: The date that the user interacted with the ad OR completed a conversion event.

custom_reports.description: Custom reports to sync. Each entry creates a destination table with the specified metrics and breakdown level.

click_attribution_window.description: Overrides the connector-level click attribution window for this report.

conversion_report_time.description: Overrides the connector-level conversion report time for this report.

granularity.description: Time granularity for the report: DAY, HOUR, WEEK, MONTH, or TOTAL.

metrics.description: List of metrics to include in the report.

report_type.description: The breakdown level for the report (e.g. ADVERTISER, CAMPAIGN, AD_GROUP, PIN_PROMOTION, KEYWORD, PRODUCT_GROUP, PRODUCT_ITEM).

table_name.description: Destination table name for this custom report.

view_attribution_window.description: Overrides the connector-level view attribution window for this report.

items.description: Custom reports to sync. Each entry creates a destination table with the specified metrics and breakdown level.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: The expiration date of the refresh token. Unix timestamp in seconds

report_granularity.description: Granularity at which reports will be

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all advertisers or specific advertisers.

timeframe_months.description: Number of months' worth of reporting data you'd like to include in your initial sync. This cannot be modified once the connector is created. Default value: `THREE`.

view_attribution_window.description: The number of days to use as the conversion attribution window for a 'view' action.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Pinterest client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Pinterest client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
